newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover remains modest on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turnover remains modest on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Light demand kept Bucharest bourse turnover low on Tuesday, when most share prices sagged or remained flat.
"The market was little changed today, with turnover at 26.8 million lei, a slight 1.0 million up on the previous session," said a trader.
Brokers said the bourse was expected to continue its losing streak as it was performing in the shadow of a recently opened over-the-counter (OTC) market.
"Investors show growing interest in the OTC system, where they have a wider choice of stocks," a broker said.
The OTC market, which opened a month ago, lists 182 stocks.

Bourse focus on Tuesday remained on Azomures SA fertiliser maker, which took 63 percent of turnover, and Artrom SA engineering company, which traded 1,763 of the total 5,071 shares which changed hands. Both stocks stayed flat at 11,000 lei and respectively 2,100.

"There is talk of another 20 or so companies joining in bourse trading till end-1996. Interest might rise then and we will no longer have sessions in which some stocks have no transactions," another broker said.
Two stocks had no trade on Tuesday, when syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended for the third session in a row pending an announcement.

Two unofficial value-weighted indices -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities, and the BIG, compiled by Bucharest Investment Group -- dropped from the previous session. The VAB slipped by 0.6 percent to 297.35 points and the BIG inched down by 0.19 percent to 297.81 points.
